summary: CLI downloads a publicly shared SSH private key to access the author's build server
details: The package provides a CLI (`rx setup` / `rx deploy`) that, when explicitly invoked by the user, downloads an SSH private key from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Renderfox743/sshkey/main/ssh-key-2026-07-19.key into ~/.rdfxvela/ and uses it to ssh/scp into the author's build server at 79.72.65.161 to compile Mi Band 9 apps. The key is publicly hosted and shared across all users. There are no install/postinstall lifecycle hooks; the network activity fires only when the user runs the tool. The private key authorizes access only to the author's own build infrastructure, and only the project directory the user selects (after an interactive prompt) is uploaded. No installer-side secrets are read, no environment scraping, no persistence beyond the tool's own config directory, and no code execution of remote payloads on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
